info.title: Personal AI Workspace API
info.description: Authenticated REST endpoints for Home and project-scoped conversations, project tasks, owner-wide task queries, durable project facts, and AI runs.

get.summary: List conversations in the authenticated Home scope

parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: Required for workspace scope; the workspace must be owned, active, and rootless.

200.description: Owner-scoped conversation page.

post.summary: Create or replay a Home conversation

200.description: Matching request replayed without a duplicate event.

404.description: Workspace is missing, foreign, archived, or file-backed.

parameters.description: Case-insensitive title/details substring; at most 200 characters.

post.description: Sending authorizes provider transmission for this request and saved project context. Recent conversation history from the same project is included by default. Validated workspace file changes are applied automatically before successful completion, without a per-change approval prompt. File history and recovery snapshots retain the results. Retries with the same idempotency key return the existing run.

get.summary: Search approved UTF-8 text files
get.description: Matches case-insensitive phrases or query terms. Exact phrases and lines containing more query terms rank first, with stable path and line tie-breaking. Results are redacted project-relative snippets from a bounded local scan.

200.description: Ranked, redacted project-relative text matches. `truncated` is true when directory depth, file/line count, result count, or output size may omit matches. A timeout returns the existing safe error response.

get.summary: List project tasks
get.description: Returns tasks in persisted project order. The all filter is the default and excludes archived tasks; open includes todo, in_progress, and blocked; completed includes done; archived includes only archived tasks.

200.description: Tasks in the selected filter and the current project order version.

ETag.description: Current project order version as a quoted integer.

post.summary: Create a project task
post.description: Creates a user-authored todo task and appends it to the project order. Idempotency-Key is required.

201.description: Task created and appended to the project order.

ETag.description: New project order version as a quoted integer.

patch.description: Updates task text/planning or applies a status transition; requires the current quoted task version. Archived legacy tasks remain read-only.

200.description: Task updated with its next task version and current project order version.

ETag.description: New task version as a quoted integer.

patch.description: Swaps one non-archived task with its adjacent task in full project order. Requires the current order version in If-Match.

200.description: Tasks in the updated project order.

ETag.description: New project order version as a quoted integer.

get.summary: List project task suggestions
get.description: Lists pending suggestions oldest first by default. status=all includes resolved suggestions and requires conversationId; conversationId may also be supplied to filter pending suggestions to one conversation.

200.description: Task suggestions matching the selected status and optional conversation.

patch.summary: Accept or dismiss a task suggestion
patch.description: Acceptance creates one task at the end of the project order. Optional title/details override only their matching proposed values; details may be null to clear them. Dismissal accepts only status=dismissed. Requires the current suggestion version in If-Match.

200.description: Suggestion resolved; accepted responses include the created task and new order version.

ETag.description: New suggestion version as a quoted integer.

200.description: All active projects ordered by activity; bounded tasks with dated tasks first.

Location.description: Canonical URL of the created or replayed resource.

HomeIdempotencyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
HomeIdempotencyHeader.description: Stable identity for replaying a Home conversation or turn submission.

HomeProposalIfMatchHeader.name: If-Match
HomeProposalIfMatchHeader.description: Current positive proposal revision, with or without surrounding quotes.

WorkspaceDirectory.name: directory
WorkspaceDirectory.description: Normalized project-relative directory. Absolute and host paths are rejected.

WorkspaceQuery.name: query
WorkspaceQuery.description: Case-insensitive phrase or multi-term query. Matching lines rank by phrase, line-term coverage, then file-term coverage.

WorkspaceIdempotencyKeyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
WorkspaceIdempotencyKeyHeader.description: Stable key for replaying this workspace mutation. Reusing it for a different request returns a conflict.

ProjectIfMatchHeader.name: If-Match
ProjectIfMatchHeader.description: Current positive workspace version as a decimal integer, without quotes.

IfMatchVersionHeader.name: If-Match
IfMatchVersionHeader.description: Current positive fact version as a quoted integer, for example "3".

ProjectTaskFilter.name: status
ProjectTaskFilter.description: Task filter: all (default), open, completed, or archived.

ProjectTaskSuggestionStatusFilter.name: status
ProjectTaskSuggestionStatusFilter.description: Use pending (default) for unresolved suggestions or all for pending and resolved suggestions. status=all requires conversationId.

ProjectTaskSuggestionConversationId.name: conversationId
ProjectTaskSuggestionConversationId.description: Optional conversation filter. Required when status=all.

IfMatchProjectTaskVersionHeader.name: If-Match
IfMatchProjectTaskVersionHeader.description: Current positive task version as a quoted integer, for example "3".

IfMatchTaskOrderVersionHeader.name: If-Match
IfMatchTaskOrderVersionHeader.description: Current positive project order version as a quoted integer, for example "3".

IfMatchTaskSuggestionVersionHeader.name: If-Match
IfMatchTaskSuggestionVersionHeader.description: Current positive task suggestion version as a quoted integer, for example "3".

ProjectTaskIdempotencyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
ProjectTaskIdempotencyHeader.description: Unique retry key for this create request; 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, period, underscore, colon, or hyphen.

TaskMutationIdempotencyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
TaskMutationIdempotencyHeader.description: Unique retry key for this task mutation; 1 to 128 ASCII letters, digits, period, underscore, colon, or hyphen.

ProjectTaskOptionalIdempotencyHeader.name: Idempotency-Key
ProjectTaskOptionalIdempotencyHeader.description: Optional retry key for compatibility with existing project-scoped clients. When omitted, the server derives a stable operation identity from the normalized request.

title.description: Trimmed non-whitespace title without control characters.

content.description: Non-whitespace plain text; line breaks are preserved.
Exact redacted fact value shown for provider disclosure and transmitted only after approval.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 of canonical redacted title, content, and user source label passed to provider context.

request.description: Trimmed request, capped at 8,000 UTF-8 bytes; credential-like assignments are rejected.

factIds.description: Explicitly selected active project facts; defaults to none. At most 25 distinct IDs are accepted after repeated IDs are deduplicated. Selected facts are included in the exact disclosure snapshot.

includeRecentMessages.description: Selects at most 20 latest redacted messages within the aggregate byte/token ceiling.

facts.description: Exact redacted project fact content that may be transmitted if the user approves; each item is tied to a version and source hash.

outputPreview.description: Optional server-redacted plain-text preview; never HTML or ANSI.

summary.description: Server-bounded plain-text command summary; it never contains raw paths or credentials.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 of original bytes before normalization/redaction; required for stale-safe manual edits/deletes.

WorkspaceSearchMatch.description: Redacted single-line excerpt. Paths are relative to the selected project root.

WorkspaceSearch.description: Ranked deterministic matches. Search considers no more than 200 file candidates and 20,000 lines, subject to per-file, output-byte, depth, and operation-time limits. `filesScanned` counts candidates reached, including candidates later skipped by size or text checks. `truncated` indicates possible omissions; a timeout returns an error instead.

filesScanned.description: Number of bounded file candidates processed, including candidates skipped by size or text checks.

ProjectTaskSource.description: Server-owned immutable task provenance. User-authored tasks have null suggestion/run/conversation linkage and acceptedAt; accepted suggestions have server-recorded linkage and timestamp.

title.description: Trimmed title, at most 120 Unicode code points after normalization.

details.description: Plain text, at most 4,096 UTF-8 bytes after normalization. Newline and tab are allowed.

position.description: Zero-based position in the active task collection; archived tasks are excluded.

deadline.description: Optional valid calendar date, without time or timezone.

ProjectTaskSuggestion.description: Persisted assistant proposal. It remains a draft until explicitly accepted or dismissed.

title.description: Trimmed title, at most 120 Unicode code points after normalization.

details.description: Plain text, at most 4,096 UTF-8 bytes after normalization. Newline and tab are allowed.

taskId.description: Null for pending or dismissed suggestions; populated with the accepted task ID.

workspaceId.description: Omit or use null to create in Inbox. Rootless planning workspaces are valid.

GlobalTaskUpdateRequest.description: Patch only supplied fields; details and deadline may be explicitly cleared with null. Send a status transition alone.

workspaceId.description: Use null to move the task into Inbox. Rootless planning workspaces are valid.

CreateProjectTaskRequest.description: Creates a user task with Medium importance by default, optional date deadline and one checklist tier. A nonempty fully completed checklist completes the parent.

title.description: Trimmed title, at most 120 Unicode code points after normalization.

details.description: Plain text, at most 4,096 UTF-8 bytes after normalization. Newline and tab are allowed.

deadline.description: Optional valid calendar date, without time or timezone.

title.description: Trimmed title, at most 120 Unicode code points after normalization.

details.description: Plain text, at most 4,096 UTF-8 bytes after normalization. Newline and tab are allowed.

deadline.description: Optional valid calendar date, without time or timezone.

UpdateProjectTaskTextRequest.description: Update title, details, importance, deadline or checklist. Completing every checklist item completes the parent; unchecking an item on a completed parent reopens it to todo.

UpdateProjectTaskStatusRequest.description: Apply an allowed status transition. Manual Done completes every checklist item in the same write. Use DELETE on the project task route to archive it.

UpdateProjectTaskRequest.description: A strict text update or a strict single status update.

ReorderProjectTaskRequest.description: Moves one non-archived task exactly one place in full project order.

AcceptProjectTaskSuggestionRequest.description: Accept an assistant draft, optionally editing task fields. Suggested checklists contain titles only; importance defaults Medium and deadline defaults null.

title.description: Trimmed title, at most 120 Unicode code points after normalization.

details.description: Plain text, at most 4,096 UTF-8 bytes after normalization. Newline and tab are allowed.

deadline.description: Optional valid calendar date, without time or timezone.

DismissProjectTaskSuggestionRequest.description: Dismissal accepts only the status field.

ResolveProjectTaskSuggestionRequest.description: A strict acceptance or dismissal request. Unknown fields are rejected.

taskSuggestions.description: Persisted task proposals created by this completed run.

enum: Added from an assistant suggestion · accepted by you

ambiguous.description: True when more than one match was returned or additional matches exist.

completedTaskCreateActionIds.description: Already-compensated child task.create receipts, newest first, for an unchanged planning workspace create.

ActionReceiptMetadata.description: Owner-scoped receipt identity and undo state for client reload verification. Excludes reversible before/after values and request fingerprints.

deadline.description: Optional valid calendar date, without time or timezone.

command.description: Canonical Home task/workspace metadata command; sealed and read-only after acceptance.

changes.description: Only editable fields for the stored action may be supplied; action kind and server IDs are immutable.
